source_caption: The Dictator (2012) is a political satire comedy starring Sacha Baron Cohen as General Aladeen, a ridiculous and tyrannical ruler of a fictional Middle Eastern country. When he gets lost in New York, he’s forced to live as an ordinary person, leading to a series of outrageous and offensive yet humorous situations. Directed by Larry Charles, the film is known for its bold satire and over-the-top comedy.
